module.purpose: Provides the organizations settings layout and prevents users without an organization association from accessing its child pages.
module.summary: This server-rendered layout obtains request headers and cookies, builds the legacy request context, and loads the authenticated session. It checks several supported organization associations on the session user, redirects unassociated users to their profile settings, and otherwise renders the nested settings content unchanged.
module.businessContext: Supports organization administration and settings access in the web application. If the guard fails, users may access an invalid settings area or legitimate organization users may be incorrectly redirected.
functions: SettingsOrganizationsLayout (~L8-18): Validates organization access before rendering settings descendants.

preconditions: The request context is available to build a legacy request from the current headers and cookies.
The children argument is a React.ReactNode.
postconditions: If the session user has an organization identifier or organization object, the supplied children are returned unchanged.
If no organization is present on the session user, the function redirects to /settings/my-account/profile.
invariants: Rendering is permitted when any of session.user.org, session.user.profile.organizationId, or session.user.profile.organization is truthy.
edgeCases: When no session exists, organization access checks fail and the request is redirected to the profile settings page.
When the session user or profile is absent, optional access yields no organization and the request is redirected.
When organization data is present in any of the three supported locations, the children are returned.
detail.summary: Asynchronously verifies that the current server session is associated with an organization before rendering the supplied children. Users without an organization are redirected to the profile settings page.
